name: Yoodli
tagline: Yoodli records a practice interview or presentation, then scores filler words, pacing, eye contact, and clarity, and suggests specific fixes. Career coaches and job seekers use it to rehearse answers before a real interview, and sales and leadership teams use it to drill presentations without needing a live audience.
